blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon, Philippines — Valencia City on Friday, Nov. 20, kicked off the construction of the new local government-owned and operated Good Samaritan Hospital, highlighted by a time capsule laying ceremony led by City Mayor Amie Galario, local officials, and employees. Funded by a loan from Landbank of the Philippines, the P250 million project will begin with major renovations and vertical expansion of the existing City Health Office building near the new bus terminal of Hagkol, Poblacion. To ensure that regular patient care and maternity services remain uninterrupted during construction, temporary relocation efforts are currently underway. READ: Red tape delaying […]...
